messages:
maria-ng: Heads up — found two CVEs hitting our runtime deps (tokenizers + fastapi). CI started failing during manylinux wheel build this morning. Need a backport + gating plan.

samir: Which CVE IDs and affected versions?

sec-bot: Security scan results: CVE-2025-1234 (tokenizers) — HIGH; CVE-2025-2345 (fastapi/starlette) — MEDIUM. Affected: tokenizers <= 0.15.1, fastapi < 0.95. Patches released upstream.

chen-wang: CI failure log snippet: ```ERROR: Could not build wheels for tokenizers, which is required to install pyproject.toml dependencies```

jordan-h: Suggest staged approach: 1) add temporary pin in pip-constraints.txt, 2) attempt poetry.lock regen in a branch, 3) if regen blows up, ship constraints-only hotpatch and backport release branch for runtime images.

maria-ng: Agree. Prioritize tokenizers (HIGH) for next hotpatch; fastapi/starlette pin can be a follow-up canary.

devops-oncall: @jordan-h what's the earliest hotpatch window? we have a deploy tomorrow morning.

jordan-h: Can do tonight 22:00 UTC. I'll open branch `security/tokenizers-2025-backport` and draft PR. Plan: run smoke canary against dedicated pool, monitor latency.

samir: Note about KMS: our artifact verification uses credentials that come from KMS alias `infra-builds`. If we rotate keys we may break wheel verification in runners. @devops-oncall pls confirm.

devops-oncall: Checking now — rotation scheduled next week, not in effect. Build runners currently use alias `infra-builds`. I'll add fallback to project-key in the runner config for the hotpatch.

chen-wang: Also adding simple preflight test in CI before packaging: `python -c 'import tokenizers; print(tokenizers.__version__)'` to catch import/build issues earlier.

maria-ng: Good. Also we need an audit-log entry for rollout, capture approvers + timestamps for compliance.

sec-bot: Reminder: create remediation ticket and tag `sec:urgent` for CVE-2025-1234. Suggested TTR (time-to-remediate) = 48h.

jordan-h: I'll open PR + include `ci:pin-constraints` commit. After merge, run full matrix on py38/39/310.

samir: If lock regen causes regressions, fallback to constraints-only patch + backport to our dedicated runtime images. That limits blast radius.

maria-ng: Approvals needed: @chen-wang for CI/tests; @devops-oncall for KMS/builds; @jordan-h to own the PR. I'll update release notes and incident log.

devops-oncall: ACK. I'll script canary rollout and provide rollback steps (previous image tag).

jordan-h: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3124 (draft) — contains constraint pin + regen attempt. Tests queued.

chen-wang: Test update: py310 matrix failing due to starlette mismatch. Pinning starlette to 0.20.4 in constraints fixes the build.

maria-ng: Okay — include tokenizers + starlette pin in the hotpatch. FastAPI minor bump to be validated after the canary.

samir: I'll add an E2E smoke against private deployment to validate KMS + wheel verification with updated artifacts.

maria-ng: :thumbsup: I'll file the SLA/audit ticket and note the approvers. Thanks all — let's sync after PR CI finishes.
